import pytest

from my_module import slugify  # adjust import as needed


class TestSlugifyBasic:
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("input_str, expected", [
        ("hello world", "hello-world"),
        ("Hello World", "hello-world"),
        ("HELLO WORLD", "hello-world"),
        ("hello", "hello"),
        ("HELLO", "hello"),
        ("", ""),
        ("hello-world", "hello-world"),  # already slugged — idempotent-ish
    ])
    def test_basic_slugify(self, input_str, expected):
        assert slugify(input_str) == expected
```

Then edge cases documenting actual behavior:

```python
class TestSlugifyEdgeCases:
    def test_multiple_spaces_become_multiple_hyphens(self):
        assert slugify("a  b") == "a--b"

    def test_leading_and_trailing_spaces(self):
        assert slugify(" hi ") == "-hi-"

    def test_only_spaces(self):
        assert slugify("   ") == "---"

    def test_tabs_and_newlines_not_replaced(self):
        assert slugify("a\tb") == "a\tb"
        assert slugify("a\nb") == "a\nb"

    def test_punctuation_preserved(self):
        assert slugify("Hello, World!") == "hello,-world!"

    def test_unicode_is_lowercased(self):
        assert slugify("Ä Ö") == "ä-ö"

    def test_numbers_unchanged(self):
        assert slugify("Item 42") == "item-42"
```
